name: carbon-arc-company-intelligence
description: Two reports on a company, using Carbon Arc data. An insights report for the company's own strategy or analytics team: where else its customers spend, whether a move is the company or the category, which customers it is losing, what an event did, and who is winning and why. And a pre-print earnings preview of a listed consumer company's quarter for an analyst: a panel read validated against the company's reported history, plus traffic versus ticket, peers and cross-dataset agreement.
